params.message:
A folded trend's old address is the slug that was live, and it stays

The projection wrote a folded trend's old address as a slug derived from its latest
headline, and rewrote it every round. A slug is set once and stays while the
headline changes, so after a round of new headlines six folded trends pointed from
addresses that had never existed and their real addresses gave a 404. The reconcile
now reads the live slugs before any card goes, and never recomputes an address it
already recorded.
